# bugsink_project (Resource)

A Bugsink project.

~> **`terraform destroy` fails by design.** Bugsink has no API to delete a project. Deleting this resource always fails with a diagnostic explaining how to run `terraform state rm` instead. Do not use this resource in any workflow that assumes destroy succeeds unconditionally (e.g. ephemeral or CI-provisioned environments).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# NOTE: terraform destroy fails by design on this resource - Bugsink has
# no API to delete a project. See the resource documentation before
# adopting it in any workflow that assumes destroy always succeeds.
#
# Changing `team` forces replacement: Bugsink has no API to move a project
# between teams.
resource "bugsink_project" "checkout" {
  team                      = bugsink_team.platform.id
  name                      = "checkout-service"
  alert_on_new_issue        = true
  alert_on_regression       = true
  retention_max_event_count = 10000
}

# dsn is computed and sensitive - only available after the resource is
# created, since Bugsink's create response doesn't include it.
output "checkout_dsn" {
  value     = bugsink_project.checkout.dsn
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Project name.
- `team` (String) ID of the team this project belongs to. Bugsink has no API to move a project between teams, so changing this forces replacement.

### Optional

- `alert_on_new_issue` (Boolean) Whether to alert on a new issue.
- `alert_on_regression` (Boolean) Whether to alert on a regression.
- `alert_on_unmute` (Boolean) Whether to alert when an issue is unmuted.
- `retention_max_event_count` (Number) Maximum number of events retained for this project.
- `visibility` (String) Project visibility.

### Read-Only

- `dsn` (String, Sensitive) Project DSN. Not present until after the first apply completes - Bugsink's create response omits it, so this provider reads it back immediately afterward.
- `grouping_mechanism` (String) Issue grouping mechanism, computed by Bugsink.
- `id` (String) Project ID, assigned by Bugsink.
- `slug` (String) Project slug, computed by Bugsink.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Projects are imported by their remote id.
terraform import bugsink_project.checkout 42
```
